title: Brunei
facts: Brunei is a small country on the island of Borneo in Southeast Asia, surrounded by the Malaysian state of Sarawak and the South China Sea.
Its capital is Bandar Seri Begawan, its official language is Malay, and its currency is the Brunei dollar.
Brunei is a sultanate and a member of ASEAN; oil and natural gas are central to its economy.
